slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Overhead press starting to pinch at the top? Lulu bumped up his weight and sets in the same week.

Shoulder pain with overhead lifting usually follows a jump in load, sets or training days rather than one bad rep. Most of the time you don't need to stop training altogether.

Try lighter weights or a shorter range, or swap to a landmine or incline press for a few weeks. Add rows, face pulls and external rotations to build support, then bring overhead work back gradually, checking how the shoulder feels the next day.

Sudden weakness or a shoulder that feels unstable is worth getting checked. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios work with lifters every week. Book online via the link in bio.
